mentions.name: Bobalearn
mentions.description: Web app for reading and generating graded Chinese stories to learn Chinese. A graded story is written with the vocabulary of a child of a chosen age, with words frequently repeated so learners can pick up meaning from surrounding context; the site makes these stories available online for free.
mentions.problem: Graded Chinese story readers are typically paid book versions, with no free online alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: Site where you can read and generate graded Chinese stories, in order to learn Chinese. What's a graded story? It's one written with the vocab of a {X} year old. Words are often repeated, so that you can learn from the left-and-right context. I normally pay for book versions of these, so I thought, why not make one that's online and free?
